faults.quote: Planning assumptions from Hollis Bay's past launches are: 30 million households shop in stores carrying Hollis Bay; 60% of “definitely would buy” and 20% of “probably would buy” shoppers actually buy in year one
faults.why: The candidate asked for Hollis Bay's annual chip bag volume. The planning assumptions don't answer that, so this releases the next data in sequence that nobody asked for.
The ask for annual chip bag volume, which the ledger doesn't hold, got no refusal and no word at all.
The candidate's $9.0M launch-cost total is correct and was already shown as a sum. Challenging it questions right math.
Scale slip: the figure is $9.0 million, not $9.

faults.quote: Before you plug anything in: you totaled variable cost at $1.55 per bag. Can you walk me through the components you added?
faults.why: The candidate misquoted the exhibit's $0.70 ingredients figure as $0.75. The interviewer probed it over two turns instead of giving a flat one-sentence correction of its own figure.

faults.quote: On the protein figure, you said 54% — walk me through where that number comes from.
faults.why: The candidate misquoted the exhibit's 52% as 54%. This is a misquote of an exhibit figure, so it called for a flat correction, not a probe.

faults.quote: As I mentioned: Planning assumptions from Hollis Bay's past launches are: 30 million households shop in stores carrying Hollis Bay;
faults.why: The candidate asked how the 500,000 sampling households were estimated. Already-released planning assumptions and survey design lines were restated as the answer, though neither answers it, and no refusal was given.
The candidate misquoted the marketing line as $4.3M when the exhibit says $4.5M. No correction ever came.

faults.quote: What would you put in place to guard against that?
faults.why: The candidate's previous answer already gave a mitigation: gating the rollout on an 8-week test read of repeat rate.

faults.quote: We've gotten through what I wanted to. Thank you for working through the case; your written report will follow.
faults.why: The candidate raised whether a co-packer could carry year-one manufacturing. The ledger holds nothing on this, and it got no refusal or acknowledgment before the close.
